prompt: Every single governed tool call in our harness is being denied, even the ones that used to work. We assume a policy was changed. What should I check first?
assertions: The response checks KEI_PROXY_DISABLED / kei-proxy disabled or misconfigured before blaming a policy change.
The response explains that a disabled, missing, or misconfigured proxy denies every governed call and never permits one.
The response uses read-only environment checks and a single kei-proxy authorize probe rather than mutating anything.
